title: A stake placed in front of a reward payment takes its share
rootCause: Lock pays rewards at once to whoever is locked when notifyUnseenReward runs, so a stake made just before a payment gets a full share, and the owner of that stake can exit straight after for less than the reward is worth.

poc.observable: test_stepping_in_front_of_a_reward_payment_earns_nothing fails with "the reward taken by a stake one block old: 500000000000000000000 != 0"
